svg.title: The urethral hammock hypothesis
svg.desc: The supporting anterior vaginal wall and fascia can provide a backboard during increased abdominal pressure. Loss of support can impair urethral closure. Intrinsic sphincter function also matters; support anatomy does not predict continence from this picture alone. View: Female midurethra, conceptual axial section. Scale: Conceptual schematic; not to scale. Units: No measured geometry; any dimensions are illustrative. Clinical review pending; no named clinician has signed off. Concept sources: DeLancey: structural support of the urethra and the hammock hypothesis (1994 anatomical study), https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8203431/; access: abstract checked; Support mechanism from cadaver anatomy; a hypothesis, not an exclusive explanation of stress incontinence. WARWIKI original vector schematic; individual illustrator not recorded. No separate figure reuse license recorded; linked sources are concept references, not artwork licenses.
